bio.text: Jack Fazzino was elected to the Connecticut House in 2022 and represents the 83rd District, which includes parts of Berlin, Meriden and Cheshire.
He is an Assistant Majority Leader and Vice Chair of the Judiciary Committee.
Born and raised in the district, he clerked for a federal judge and worked as a lawyer, and was previously an elected Town Councilor in Berlin.
He has a B.A. from the University of Notre Dame, an M.A. from Georgetown University and a J.D. from Boston College Law School.
